technical_and_design_decisions: Build the Receptor Java client (U1) as a lightweight REST client module using standard Java HTTP capabilities and Jackson JSON binding.
Decouple stream/job definition repositories (U2) from module deployment by separating metadata storage interfaces from runtime deployment state.
Design the Pluggable Runtime SPI (U3) to provide abstract lifecycle management (deploy, undeploy, status) for deployment targets like Cloud Foundry, Mesos, and Local/On-Premise.
Implement stream state persistence (U4) using the existing repository abstraction backed by persistent storage to allow recovery of streaming pipelines on failure.
Integrate Spark/Spark Streaming (U6) via dedicated pipeline launchers/adapters adhering to latest Spring XD stream specifications.
Expose individual Sqoop import options (U8) as first-class strongly-typed options to eliminate generic '--args' usage.
assumptions: Development work will be carried out by a single developer familiar with Java 17, Spring Framework, Spring XD/Data Flow architectures, and relevant ecosystem tools.
External systems (Diego/Receptor API, Spark, Sqoop, Mesos, Cloud Foundry) have accessible specs and mock/test environments available for local integration testing.
Documentation updates will be written in standard AsciiDoc/Markdown formats within the existing repository documentation structure.

activities.activity_description: Implement DTOs, API endpoints, HTTP client wrapper, and integration unit tests for Diego Receptor REST API calls.
Refactor repository interfaces and domain models to decouple definition management from module deployment logic and update dependent modules.

activities.activity_name: Define and Implement Pluggable Runtime SPI (U3)
activities.activity_description: Define Core Runtime SPI interfaces for application deployment, refactor current implementation into SPI structure, and provide baseline deployment adapters.

activities.activity_name: Implement Persistent Stream Repository and Recovery (U4)
activities.activity_description: Develop persistent repository storage for stream metadata and state, and implement recovery logic to re-establish pipes upon failure.
Build adapters and pipeline support for Spark and Spark Streaming jobs aligned with updated XD stream specs.
Refactor Sqoop module configuration to parameterize all import options, replacing generic --args parser with explicit options and updating tests.
Write documentation for Sqoop double escaping (\\N) and create reference guides and examples for nesting batch jobs and workflows in XD.
Perform overall system integration testing across the new runtime SPI, persistent streams, Receptor client, and updated user stories.
